title: Calibrating Generated Items Before Pretesting with Predicted Priors
text: Honest predictive SD, two kinds. --fold RMSE families seen training, leave-one-family-RMSE new templates. Robust prior. default Student-t (df = 4) lets data override bad prediction instead dragged toward . Family-level trust check. chi-square test prior-data conflict per family; cs_distrust() withdraws priors failing families.

title: Calibrating Generated Items Before Pretesting with Predicted Priors
text: Predictive SDs honest: stated 0.54 vs actual RMSE 0.53 (seen families), 0.70 vs 0.64 (unseen family); 90% intervals cover 90.8% 90.4%. RMSE difficulty, seen families: prior, 25 responses 50 without . Drifted (“rogue”) template family (+1.2 logits vs history): prior alone hurts (0.66 vs 0.61 n = 25). cs_check flags family 80% replications n = 25 100% n ≥ 50, 0.2 false family flags per replication. cs_distrust(), RMSE back baseline (0.57 n = 25). Planner: target posterior SD 0.30 needs median 40 responses per item prior vs 57 without; achieved SD 0.302, RMSE 0.300.

code: sim <- cs_simulate(n_train = 200, n_new = 60, seed = 1) it <- sim$items; tr <- it$set == "train" pr <- cs_predictor(it$b_legacy[tr], sim$features[tr, ], it$family[tr], seed = 1) pred <- predict(pr, sim$features[!tr, ], it$family[!tr]) cal <- cs_calibrate(cs_responses(sim, 25, seed = 2), pred) truth <- it$b_true[match(cal$item, it$item)] c(baseline = sqrt(mean((cal$base_mean - truth)^2)),   predicted_prior = sqrt(mean((cal$post_mean - truth)^2))) #>        baseline predicted_prior  #>       0.4457531       0.4501109

title: Plan pretest sample sizes for a target precision — cs_plan
text: Uses normal approximation `posterior precision = 1 / prior_sd^2 + n * (b)`, `(b)` average information one response item's difficulty pretest population, evaluated predicted difficulty. Compares responses needed predicted prior conventional (-prior) requirement `1 / (target_sd^2 * (b))`.

title: Simulate an item bank with features and known difficulties — cs_simulate
text: Difficulty `b = X w + family effect + noise`. Legacy (`train`) items calibrated difficulties large samples (true value plus `legacy_se` error).
